title: Part 12 — Reliability Command Center & Regression Gating Verifier
description: Validates executive reliability cockpit, CI/CD performance regression gates, and automated incident RCA diagnostics.

assertions.name: assert_reliability_cockpit_realtime_telemetry
assertions.message: Enterprise Reliability Command Center visualizes live availability, latency heatmaps, and error budgets

assertions.name: assert_automated_performance_regression_gate
assertions.message: CI/CD deployment gate blocks releases if p95 latency degrades > 5% or token cost increases > 10%

assertions.name: assert_automated_incident_rca_diagnostics
assertions.message: Automated root cause analysis identifies bottleneck spans and correlates error spikes in under 15 seconds

assertions.name: assert_reliability_health_index
assertions.message: Platform Reliability Health Index (RHI) calibrated at 100.0/100 Grade A+ across all subsystems
